interpretation.prior: Goldreich–Peale spin-orbit separatrix-flux framework; use the supplied lag-sign law, not a substituted tidal law.
interpretation.single_passage: Averaged leading-order separatrix estimate with uniform incoming energy phase in the narrow flux interval. Not an exact probability for the unaveraged dynamics or for six equally spaced initial angles.
interpretation.unknown_initial_conditions: The source gives neither the exact positive spin offset nor the starting anomaly. The primary choice and the two sensitivity choices are assumptions.
interpretation.six_state_measure: At each fixed epoch and offset, equal mass 1/6 at each specified psi. The reported fraction interval assigns unresolved states first all to escape and then all to capture. It is not a binomial confidence interval.
interpretation.convergence: Agreement under step halving is a numerical check, not an error bound; disagreements and unfinished or failed audits are unresolved. No pooling across epochs or spin offsets.
interpretation.capture: Operational finite-time classification from deep same-well stroboscopic dwell, not a proof of infinite-time trapping.
interpretation.escape: Subresonant spin and sustained net backward winding through more than two resonant wells.
